name: Carrot Cake Smoothie with Mango, Coconut & Walnuts
instructions: This recipe will make about 8 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash, peel, and trim off the ends of the carrots. Chop into 1-inch chunks and add to blender.
Wash, dry, peel, and slice ginger; add to blender. (If you have a high powered blender, you can put the peeled chunk in whole).
Peel bananas, break into chunks and add to blender.
Add almond milk, yogurt, mango, walnuts, coconut, cinnamon, and 8 ice cubes to the blender.
Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses, top with shredded coconut and enjoy!
author: Mealime
